title: Entries already on ShopView Review stay there after the row is mapped
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure the test location is connected to QuickBooks Online, with Inventory Asset and Cost of Parts mapped on its ShopView Accounts page, and that AccountingHub is not enabled.
  • Have access to the QuickBooks Online company of the test location, so its journal entries can be read.
  • Have a new No Charge category for this test, category A, with no QuickBooks account.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new No Charge work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, category category A, closed, with one approved line with one stock part picked from inventory at a cost of $40.00 each, quantity 2, whose entry posted to ShopView Review.
custom_steps:
1. Open Integrations > QuickBooks.
  2. Pick an expense account in category A's row.
  3. Click Save.
  4. In QuickBooks Online, open the journal entries for work order 1's number.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The QuickBooks page opens.

Step 2:

  • The account shows.

Step 3:

  • The mapping is saved.

Step 4:

  • The $80.00 entry is still on the ShopView Review account.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11762 (Story 5, QuickBooks Online account mapping)

  • S5-R3: “Save stores the mapping for the location. The row and the category dialog (S1-R14) read and write the same mapping, so a change in either place shows in the other. Entries posted to ShopView Review before the row was mapped stay where they are; the accountant reclasses them in QuickBooks.”
